title: Pilobol.us P3-11: staging site (staging.pilobol.us, Cognito-gated drafts preview) and staging release-gate checks
description:
## Goal
Stand up the staging site for Pilobol.us as the standard defines: draft articles rendered as if published, at staging.pilobol.us, behind the site's own Cognito (editor and admin only), and discharge the staging release-gate items.

## Context (FACT unless marked)
- Standard (docs/standard-site.md 1.10, docs/site-hosting.md "Static staging"): CMS app branch staging builds frontend-only against the production backend (ampx generate outputs --branch main), exports drafts with the JWT lane, runs the reader build, uploads the output to the private preview/ prefix, and the Next app serves it through a Cognito-gated route (AppSync/S3 enforce editor/admin, not just the page gate). Env on staging only: SITE_ENV=staging, PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW=static, NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_STAGING_URL.
- The infra template creates the staging branch, the staging.<domain> Amplify domain and the generated staging build spec; the build spec runs the repo's reader.buildCommand.
- Release gates still open for staging (epic comments c91ed6, 19753b): (a) PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW only on the staging branch, never main; (b) the 6 MB WEB_COMPUTE response limit vs proxied images: the largest file in the Pilobol.us build is 6,047,745 bytes (assets/he-said-he-could-see-it/gowy-fall-of-icarus.jpg), just under 6 MiB (6,291,456); (c) static staging proven only in a scratch sandbox (PR #127 proved the Pretext/drafts and content-actions parts live; static-staging remained a plan); (d) nodejs middleware runtime.
- CODE-READING FINDING (unproven live): with the current pilobol-us brand (newsroomBasePath "" and rootRoute newsroom) the staging gate loops for anonymous users: gated / redirects to /newsroom, middleware redirects /newsroom to /. The scaffold ticket sets newsroomBasePath "/newsroom" and a redirect root; this ticket proves it.
- Staging reads the production backend (decision 15): drafts are the 3 imported drafts.
- Hosted zone pilobol.us (Z09961547QX1VHIXOBD7) is in this account; CloudFormation domain creation validates the certificate and writes records.

## Exact steps
1. Pilobol.us: ensure infra/site.json enables the staging branch and domain (adoption flags from the infra ticket) and papyrus.config.ts has stagingBuild enabled (it is, from the scaffold).
2. Ryan yes (LIVE): run the reviewed change set (papyrus-infra changeset) that adds branch staging (stage EXPERIMENTAL, its env and generated build spec) and the domain staging.pilobol.us. Check the change set shows additions only. Ryan connects branch staging if the console requires it (GitHub App moment: branch connect).
3. Add the git branch staging in Pilobol.us (from main) so Amplify builds it. Watch the first job; spec must run: npm ci, ampx generate outputs, papyrus auth refresh-jwt, export-published --drafts, reader build, upload-preview, next build.
4. Verify as in scripts/staging-auth-test.mjs (adapt the probes): anonymous GET / -> redirect to /newsroom -> 200 sign-in page (NO loop: follow redirects with a limit); editor GET /articles/the-glass-that-wouldnt-look.html (a draft) -> 200 with the STAGING banner and that draft text; the same URL on https://pilobol.us is 404; non-editor signed in -> 403; GET /robots.txt Disallow all; page has noindex; unsigned https://<bucket>.s3.amazonaws.com/preview/... -> 403; aws s3api list-objects-v2 --prefix preview/ lists the built site; get-bucket-policy-status IsPublic false.
5. Measure the biggest asset through the gate as an editor (curl -w "%{size_download} %{http_code}" on /assets/he-said-he-could-see-it/gowy-fall-of-icarus.jpg). If it fails, the fallback is a redirect to a presigned URL (Papyrus ticket) or excluding files over 5 MB from the preview upload (staging only; production unaffected).
6. aws amplify get-branch for main shows no PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW and SITE_ENV production (names/equality only).
7. Record results; check the nodejs middleware runtime works on staging and main.

## Acceptance checks
- All step 4 probes pass; steps 5 and 6 recorded; production newsroom.pilobol.us unchanged (still 200, robots production).

## Rollback
aws amplify delete-branch --app-id d11eu9hbs2mipk --branch-name staging and remove the domain via the stack (reverse change set). preview/ objects can be deleted (Ryan yes). Production untouched.

## Risks
- Staging reads the production backend; the drafts export needs the editor/JWT lane: the CMS service role has AdministratorAccess by template design (documented risk).
- Build time: staging build does a full reader build plus Next build (about 10-15 minutes).
- Python 3.12 on the CMS build image: same unproven assumption as the reader ticket.

## Needs Ryan
Yes for step 2; the sign-in checks need an editor account and a non-editor account (Ryan signs in, or approves creating a test non-editor user and deleting it); domain/certificate waits are automatic.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.
